name: Rates & Government Bonds
description: Government bonds, swaps, and interest-rate curves: yields, spreads, and rate sensitivity.

metrics.name: curve_spread
metrics.description: Difference between two curve points (e.g., 10y minus 2y)

metrics.name: dv01
metrics.description: Change in value for a one-basis-point parallel move in yield

metrics.name: modified_duration
metrics.description: Percent price change per 100 bp yield change

metrics.name: notional
metrics.description: Notional outstanding at a point in time

conventions.rule: Report changes in yields and spreads in basis points (1 bp = 0.01 percentage point), not percent change.
State the day-count and compounding convention (e.g., ACT/360, 30/360, semi-annual) for any yield.
State the DV01 sign convention (value change for a +1 bp move); signs differ across systems.
Macro and rate series can be revised; use vintage data for historical as-of questions.

insight_rules.reason: Yields are rates; attribute P&L through DV01 times the bp move instead.

caveats.text: A move from 4.00% to 4.20% is +20 bp, not +5%; this response reports basis points.

chart_conventions.rule: Plot curves with tenor on the x-axis (ordered by maturity, not alphabetically) and one line per date.

review.notes: Drafted from public, general industry conventions; not yet reviewed by a named domain owner.
